note: Rename… edits the changelist's name in the Shelf tab's tree, as the reference app's tree does: Enter keeps the name typed, Escape leaves the old one.

steps.sh:
mkdir -p src .idea/shelf/Fix_readme && echo 'fn a() {}' > src/a.rs && git add -N src/a.rs && printf '/shelf/
' > .idea/.gitignore && git diff README.md src/a.rs > .idea/shelf/Fix_readme/shelved.patch && printf '<changelist name="Fix_readme" date="1767261600000" recycled="false" deleted="false">
  <option name="DESCRIPTION" value="Fix readme" />
</changelist>
' > .idea/shelf/Fix_readme.xml && git checkout -- README.md && git rm -q --cached src/a.rs && rm -rf src

steps.keys: cmd-a r e n a m e d enter
